text.en: Personal affixes are indexed on verbs, while independent personal pronouns are optional and employed primarily for topicalization or deliberate emphasis of the subject ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--affixes-obligatory-pronouns-emphatic⟧⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--a-subject-in-ainu-is-normally-expressed-by⟧. Person and number are obligatorily marked on the verb, and these participant specifications cannot be omitted even when clear from the context ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--in-ainu-person-and-number-are-obligatorily-marked⟧⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--participant-information-such-as-who-does-what-to⟧. Personal pronouns and adverbial particles may precede the verb, yet the personal affixes remain attached even in the presence of an independent personal pronoun ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--personal-pronouns-and-adverbial-particles-may-precede-the⟧. Personal affixes, together with nominal prefixes equivalent to concept forms, function to decrease verb arity ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--affixes-that-decrease-arity-are-nominal-prefixes-equivalent⟧. Across Hokkaido, the attachment of personal affixes differs markedly between the Biratori and Nukibetsu dialects on the one hand and Horobetsu on the other, Horobetsu aligning more closely with Obihiro, Kushiro, and Asahikawa ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--the-way-personal-affixes-attach-differs-greatly-between⟧. Kindaichi first identified these morphemes as personal affixes rather than independent pronouns as Batchelor had described them ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--kindaichi-was-the-first-to-point-out-that⟧. Although verbs in principle take personal affixes, forms lacking them do occur, though such occurrences remain relatively rare and exceptional ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--although-verbs-in-ainu-in-principle-take-personal⟧. In Ainu clause structure, both nouns and verbs inflect for person, grammatical relations are signaled by personal affixes, and arguments are satisfied within the core by these affixes while independent noun phrases appear outside the core as optional elements ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--ainu-nouns-and-verbs-inflect-for-person⟧⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--in-ainu-grammatical-relations-are-indicated-by-personal⟧⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--in-ainu-clause-structure-arguments-are-satisfied-by⟧. Ainu makes extensive use of these affixes ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--ainu-makes-extensive-use-of-personal-affixes⟧. In the Saru dialect, person-marking forms comprise both personal pronouns and personal affixes ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--person-marking-forms-in-the-saru-dialect-consist⟧. Across Ainu dialects, considerable variation exists both in the inventory of person categories and in the usage of each person-marking device ⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--there-is-considerable-dialect-variation-across-ainu-both⟧.
text.ja: 人称接辞は動詞に義務的に標示されるのに対し、独立した人称代名詞は随意的であり、主に主題化や主語を意図的に強調するために用いられる⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--affixes-obligatory-pronouns-emphatic⟧⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--a-subject-in-ainu-is-normally-expressed-by⟧。アイヌ語では人称と数が動詞接辞によって動詞上に義務的に標示され、誰が誰に何をするかといった参与者情報は文脈から明らかな場合でも省略できない⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--in-ainu-person-and-number-are-obligatorily-marked⟧⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--participant-information-such-as-who-does-what-to⟧。人称代名詞や副詞的粒子は動詞の前に置かれうるが、人称代名詞が存在する場合でも動詞には人称接辞が付加されたままである⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--personal-pronouns-and-adverbial-particles-may-precede-the⟧。概念形相当の名詞的接頭辞とともに、人称接辞はアリティを減少させる接辞である⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--affixes-that-decrease-arity-are-nominal-prefixes-equivalent⟧。人称接辞の付き方は平取・貫気別方言と幌別方言の間で大きく異なり、この点に関して幌別方言は帯広・釧路・旭川などの方言とより類似している⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--the-way-personal-affixes-attach-differs-greatly-between⟧。バチェラーが代名詞と呼んだ形式について、人称接辞であると最初に指摘したのは金田一であった⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--kindaichi-was-the-first-to-point-out-that⟧。動詞には原則として人称接辞が表示されるものの、現れない事例も存在し、全体からみれば比較的稀で例外的である⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--although-verbs-in-ainu-in-principle-take-personal⟧。アイヌ語の文構造において名詞と動詞は人称変化をし、文法関係は人称接辞によって表示され、項は中核（CORE）内の人称接辞によって満たされるため、独立した名詞句は随意的な要素として中核の外側に配置される⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--ainu-nouns-and-verbs-inflect-for-person⟧⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--in-ainu-grammatical-relations-are-indicated-by-personal⟧⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--in-ainu-clause-structure-arguments-are-satisfied-by⟧。アイヌ語は人称接辞を広汎に使用する⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--ainu-makes-extensive-use-of-personal-affixes⟧。沙流方言の人称表現形式には人称代名詞と人称接辞がある⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--person-marking-forms-in-the-saru-dialect-consist⟧。アイヌ語には人称の種類の目録にも各人称表現形式の用法にもかなりの方言差が存在する⟦claim:person/person-marking-architecture--there-is-considerable-dialect-variation-across-ainu-both⟧。
